ValidationRule.description: A CASE-ranked status ladder gates Critical priority, completion percent, drafts, high-priority approval and on-hold notes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'Critical'), CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) < 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0) < 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft'), NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0) > 0.1), AND(CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) >= 2, NOT(Is_Approved__c), CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'High', 1, 'Critical', 1, 0) = 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'On Hold'), ISBLANK(Notes__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status, priority, completion, approval and notes are not consistent.
